text:
sam: Quick checklist for tomorrow's oncall handoff (calling this the 'bootstrapping' pass). Please confirm you're green on these before 09:50 UTC:
- VPN / Okta MFA
- Pager assigned & tested
- SSH keys present in vault / can reach bastion
- Runbook access + runbook small fixes noted
- Grafana / Sentry dashboards load
- kubeconfig / kubectl context available
- Smoke page test works

alina: Going through now. VPN + Okta MFA are fine for me. Where's the pager request flow? :thinking:

sam: Pager requests via the internal portal (include team:eng-oncall tag). Portal link: https://portal.redwood.internal/pager-requests

mohit: Added my SSH pubkey to vault at `secrets/ssh/oncall/mohit`. Can someone verify SSH to bastion for me? Also runbook link here: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-bootstrapping

jess: Verified for mohit — I SSH'd using `ssh -i ~/.ssh/oncall_mohit ubuntu@bastion.redwood` and got a shell. :thumbsup:

eng-oncall-bot: test page sent to mohit's pager (pager id:3721) — delivery confirmed at 07:22 UTC

alina: Grafana + Sentry permissions look good from my account; dashboards load. One FYI: alert routing for `model-serving-prod` currently points to the old team alias. I can open a tiny PR to update routing to `eng-ml` before handoff.

mohit: Runbook step 4 mentions `kubectl --context prod` but doesn't say where prod kubeconfig lives. FYI prod kubeconfig is in vault at `secrets/kube/prod` — we should add that note.

sam: Good catch. Alina — can you update alert routing? I'll add the kubeconfig path to the runbook. I'll take final handoff at 09:50 UTC and do a live verification: send a test page + check metrics streaming.

jess: Quick note — I rotated my admin session token yesterday. If you need an Admin SA token for a smoke check, please open a ticket to `sec-automation` and include justification.

alina: Quick Q — escalation to SRE offline: runbook says pager -> phone -> slack huddle. Do we have up-to-date phone numbers?

sam: Phone list is in /ops/contacts (Okta-protected). For immediate escalation include `@sre-lead` on the page. I'll DM the phone list to whoever needs it right now.

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled runbook test at 08:00 UTC — will auto-page the current oncall for verification.

mohit: I'm green on everything. Re-sending the smoke page helps: run `pager test --id 3721` or use the portal test button.

sam: Thanks — if no objections, I'll mark handoff ready and post final confirmation at 09:50 UTC.

(Notes: kept short steps in runbook to avoid ambiguity; update routing + kubeconfig path before final handoff.)
